title.narrative: DRAWING UP A NATIONAL PLAN FOR SMART CITIES IN CAMEROON

description.narrative:
As part of its cooperation with Cameroon, UN-Habitat supports the Government in its urban modernization efforts advocated in the National Development Strategy 2030 (SND 30), aiming to contribute to the achievement of the SDGs. Following the development of the National Urban Policy (NUP), the dialogue aimed at strengthening national and local capacities in mastering planning and urban management instruments continues. During 2021-2022, the two parties initiated a reflection on the need to harmonize approaches for promoting smart cities and supporting municipalities in implementing managed urban planning tools. This was piloted in the localities of Mokolo and Fotokol. The project aims to strengthen the capacities of public and decentralized institutions to develop and adopt a reference framework for harmonizing methods and approaches for the development of Smart Cities in Cameroon, as well as specific urban planning plans in five municipalities.
This will be achieved through a holistic and participatory strategic approach, aiming to establish a harmonized reference framework for the development of smart cities and spatially controlled in the Cameroonian context. Here is how the different components of the project contribute to its objectives:
1. Overview of smart city projects and initiatives : • This first component consists of an in-depth diagnosis of existing smart city projects and initiatives in Cameroon. The aim is to understand the specific challenges and opportunities linked to the digital transformation of each municipality. • A territorial diagnostic study will be carried out to assess the use of information and communication technologies in urban management. This will make it possible to identify relevant projects and define the concept of intelligent cities adapted to local specificities. 2. Identify the key areas for digital transformation and draw up a guide: • The second component focuses on identifying the strategic axes that will guide the transformation of smart cities in Cameroon. This includes defining the main thrusts of the digital transformation. • A guide to smart cities will be drawn up, detailing the methodology for this transformation. The aim is to ensure a common understanding and consistent implementation of the concept by all stakeholders. 3. Development of strategic action plans : • The third component aims to develop strategic action plans for implementing the smart city categories, in line with the Assembly's recommendations. • These action plans will include the mechanisms needed for the digital transformation of Cameroon's cities, guiding the government's efforts to improve living conditions while reducing environmental impact. Theory of change : • The underlying theory of change is based on an iterative process of diagnosis, identification of areas for transformation, formulation of a clear guide, and training of institutions and governments in approaches specific to smart cities. • By successfully completing these stages, the project aims to develop a strategic action plan that will guide urban interventions, thereby promoting a better quality of life and sustainable social development in Cameroon. To sum up, this project adopts a structured approach, ranging from the assessment of the existing situation to the formulation of action plans, with the aim of implementing smart cities in Cameroon in line with international standards and local needs.
